blockers.title: Historical Change-Detector Digest Drift (5 Tests Failing by Contract)
blockers.description: Five legacy change-detector tests fail because they assert raw disk line-ending match against an uncommitted pre-Phase-4 Windows CRLF digest (c52e648c...). Per safety rule #7, historical strategy pins are preserved unchanged. Inherited from BLOCK-177-01.
blockers.evidence_required: Formal baseline reset process approved across all versioned records
blockers.closure_criteria: Approved migration to versioned strategy identity invariants without modifying historical files

blockers.title: Simulated Queue Dynamics Calibration Unverified Empirically
blockers.description: Queue fill probability formula (P = 1 - exp(-lambda*t/Q)) is a mathematical block-hazard heuristic. Lacks calibration against empirical order-level queue position and high-frequency cancellation feeds. Inherited from BLOCK-177-02.
blockers.evidence_required: Market-by-Order (MBO) order-level message feed with synchronized private fill tracking
blockers.closure_criteria: Empirical calibration of arrival intensity and cancellation rates with out-of-sample fill validation

blockers.title: Non-Overlapping Signal and Execution Datasets (44-Day Gap Confirmed)
blockers.description: Available 1-minute candle data (data/history/BTCUSDT/1m.parquet) covers September 5, 2026. High-frequency Level-2 order book updates cover October 19, 2026. Independently confirmed 44-day gap with zero temporal overlap. Inherited from BLOCK-177-03.
blockers.evidence_required: Concurrent 1-minute candle and high-frequency Level-2 depth data covering the identical observation window
blockers.closure_criteria: Synchronized historical replay showing signal generation and execution fill against contemporaneous order books

blockers.title: Authenticated Fill Evidence Severely Underpowered (N=2)
blockers.description: Only 2 valid authenticated testnet fills exist for BTCUSD. Sample size is far below the minimum N >= 30 requirement. Inherited from BLOCK-177-04.
blockers.evidence_required: At least 30 independently attributable, authenticated fills under controlled execution conditions
blockers.closure_criteria: Reconciliation of at least 30 fills with exchange trade IDs, wallet cashflows, and zero unreconciled residuals

blockers.closure_criteria: Controlled execution of bounded testnet experiment protocol in accordance with Section 10 rules

blockers.title: Tick Size Discrepancy Resolved (0.10 Authoritative Grid Enforced)

blockers.closure_criteria: Regression tests passing; zero conflicting metadata in active code

blockers.title: Mathematically Subsumed Hurdle Rule 2 Retained for Compatibility
blockers.description: Rule 1 (fee ratio <= 40%) strictly subsumes Rule 2 (target multiple >= 2.0x). Rule 2 is redundant but retained for serialized output compatibility and operator parameter independence. Inherited from BLOCK-177-08.

blockers.closure_criteria: Documented compatibility confirmation or unified single-hurdle formulation
